scope: Read-only review of coherent controller snapshot publication, target measurement handoff, fixed task logger, JSON paging and stopped retained-window MSL export; no production edits or subagents.
verdict: No unresolved source or final-image binding issue in reviewed logger/snapshot paths. All three supplied ELF hashes match; final target frame/allocation checks and independent ISR placement reruns pass. Physical timing and runtime stack/heap headroom remain unmeasured.
coherence_and_locking: RuntimeSample is built from the same final bound Inputs and controller Output as its submitted command, with its own 64-bit sequence and GP clock timestamps. Failed observe try-lock leaves the caller cache intact, retaining the older timestamps and revisions.

Earlier worker command observation is copied under the executor portMUX and carries separate sequence/revisions/fault/masks. It is explicitly not proof that the new controller proposal executed. PhaseEpoch is external configuration context; WorkerEpoch is executor generation.

Producer task uses logger mutex try-lock(0), then bounded fixed-size accounting/copy only. HTTP page copying and export-row reads use the task mutex; all JSON, formatting, network sends and per-row vTaskDelay occur after releasing it. No new logger call, allocation, JSON, flash, network I/O or floating point was added to the ISR paths.

A copied 16-row page is an immutable point-in-time observation. A later overwrite or new log does not retroactively invalidate it. IDs and boot headers distinguish old pages; copied_page discloses that this is not a current-at-transmission guarantee.

MSL exports require a frozen nonempty ring. A lease prevents rearming while rows are streamed, without holding the logger mutex across formatting or network I/O. Disconnect/error returns unwind the local lease.

Sample revisions, timing faults, masks and ages preserve configuration transitions and stale observations. Ring source/sequence/presence and future control/sample timestamps are checked before retaining a row; invalid sensor inputs serialize as null/NaN.

resolved_findings.issue: Unobserved due sampling slots at explicit stop or timeout were omitted from missed_periods.
resolved_findings.resolution: missed_through counts remaining due slots; timeout uses deadline-1, making deadline exclusive. Explicit stop includes a due slot at stop time.
resolved_findings.validation: ASan/UBSan independent probe: terminal timeout misses=9, stop misses=5; 360 randomized/deterministic full-session accounting cases pass.

resolved_findings.issue: make_unique<Page>, and the first new(nothrow) replacement, could abort on target allocation failure with the pinned no-exceptions IDF stubs.
resolved_findings.resolution: Page and Tune helper use checked malloc, placement new for non-allocating constructors and free deleter. Selected and generic sdkconfig leave heap-abort-on-failure disabled.
resolved_findings.validation: Pinned libstdc++ new/new(nothrow) disassembly and IDF cxx_exception_stubs inspected. Final selected/generic ELF Page and Tune helpers, and final dummy Tune helper, independently disassembled: malloc call, null-result branch, non-allocating constructor only on success. All three SDK configurations disable heap-abort-on-failure.

resolved_findings.issue: HTTPD priority 5 could monopolize CPU while serializing writable JSON/MSL responses above the app/control task priority 1.
resolved_findings.resolution: vTaskDelay(1) after each bounded JSON or MSL row, outside mutex. One-row DOM limits simultaneous server-side JSON allocations.
resolved_findings.validation: Source recheck of both response loops; no physical duration or preemption measurement claimed.

resolved_findings.issue: MSL retained-window metadata originally omitted loss/session details needed to interpret exported data.
resolved_findings.resolution: MSL metadata now includes boot/log identity, period/duration, retained range, overwritten/missed/repeated/invalid counters and epoch domains.
resolved_findings.validation: Source recheck and recompiled ASan/UBSan native test confirm 58 matching name/unit/data columns including InputValidMask. Independent stress probe: 1290-byte maximum-counter header and 501-byte stress row fit 2048-byte formatter buffer; undersized buffers return false.

resolved_findings.issue: A POST with a query string could mutate recording state then fail when responding through the page-query GET path.
resolved_findings.resolution: POST rejects any query before boot/body parsing or start/stop mutation.

resolved_findings.issue: PhaseEpoch and WorkerEpoch initially looked directly comparable despite having separate counter domains.
resolved_findings.resolution: JSON and MSL now explicitly label external_configuration_context vs executor_generation.
resolved_findings.validation: Source recheck of data_json worker observation and MSL metadata.

resolved_findings.issue: Recorder::page created a full 3544-byte temporary on the HTTP stack while holding the logger mutex.
resolved_findings.resolution: Reset metadata/count/flags only, then copy valid rows; entries beyond count remain unspecified and are never serialized.
resolved_findings.validation: All final web ELF Recorder::page entry instructions encode a 32-byte frame, agreeing with pinned target cache -fstack-usage compile. Earlier image frame was 3584 bytes. Native re-used Page, identity and gap tests pass after metadata-only reset.

streaming_failure_model.limitations: Mirrors one-row JSON DOM streaming and models a client accepting only completed parseable JSON. It is not an ESP HTTPD/socket test. Header in this independent model includes a subset of endpoint metadata; native cJSON peak excludes Page, socket, allocator overhead and client string allocations.

actual_service_with_host_fixtures.limitations: Compiles actual engine_log_service.cpp against std::mutex/atomic fake RTOS+GP clock, using ASan/UBSan. Producer nonblocking check is a host scheduling assertion, not a physical latency measurement.

repository_native_regression.result: pass after final 58-column and zero-session source updates

independent_validation.compilation: Native probes: g++ -std=c++17 -O1 -g -fno-omit-frame-pointer -fsanitize=address,undefined; pinned ESP-IDF cJSON C object, -pthread for service fixture. Target sizes: pinned xtensa-esp32s3-elf-g++ 14.2.0. Current task source stack compilation reuses CMake compile includes/options, explicitly adding selected PlatformIO defines ECU_COMPACT_A3=1 ECU_CONFIG_WEB=1 ECU_SELECTED_N16R8=1 and -std=gnu++17 -fstack-usage; output objects/depfiles remain in cache.
independent_validation.target_frame_limits: Individual decoded ELF/compiler frames only, not a complete system/library call-stack bound. All three images: app_main6592, observe800, worker3184+command helper2160, capture ISR128, alarm ISR112. Web images: HTTP page112+Recorder::page32, MSL2368+formatter112, diagnostic ISR96. Main/timing/HTTP task stacks configured16KiB; ISR stack1536. Runtime high-water remains unmeasured.

Page helper is absent from dummy image because HTTP endpoints are not linked. No allocating operator new call occurs in these helpers.

image_binding.state: All three final supplied images independently hash-matched. Actual ELF ENTRY frames and heap helper disassembly checked; all three static ISR placement audits rerun independently against these exact bytes. All reviewed source hashes recorded after final source changes.
image_binding.ram_limit_caution: Static data+bss is not free internal heap: IRAM aliases, task stacks, WiFi/network buffers, fragmentation and allocations also consume resources.

remaining_limits: No connected ESP32 execution, flashing, physical output or electrical measurement. Selected N16R8 output policy source gates remain unchanged.
Physical IRQ duration/latency, capture latch overwrite/polarity races, actual timing jitter, AP/radio load interaction, minimum internal heap and task/ISR stack high-water remain unmeasured.

Native allocation failure tests cover checked JSON trees/stream completion semantics; they do not prove entire existing firmware tolerates global heap exhaustion, network stack OOM or all legacy std::string allocations.
Wireless protocol/session semantics and browser collector behavior have separate reviews/tests; this report does not substitute for their final validation.
